correctness.rationale: Walsh Parseval gives Var f<=1/4 sum E(Δ_i f)^2<=d/4, equality iff f=c+sum ε_i x_i with ε_i=±1. Unit chords to triples require |sum_(i in S) ε_i|<=1, exactly Property B. For δ=d/4-Var f the deficit identity bounds high-order ||h||²<=δ and sum(1-t_i²)<=8δ; a monochromatic triple forces 8δ+2^(1+d/2)sqrtδ>=2, impossible for δ<=2^(-d-1) and d>=3. Classical NP-complete monotone NAE-3-Sat with three distinct variables reduces identically to chord triples; certificate length depends on appearing variables, not binary d. Independently enumerated all 128 Fano sign assignments (noncolorability), all single shortcuts in d=3..8 with preserving sign witnesses, and the symbolic deficit inequalities. Finite checks are not the all-d proof.

final_claim: For Q_d with uniform vertex measure and unit shortcuts from origin to selected weight-three vertices, sharp Lipschitz variance d/4 is preserved iff the triple system is two-colorable; all maximizing affine sign functions are classified, every NO case has spread loss >2^(-d-1), and succinct recognition is NP-complete.
limitations: Only common-origin triples, real Lipschitz maps and uniform measure; decision complexity is succinct representation; no sharp loss magnitude outside preservation.
